Its evidence is mainly from related refractory HEAs rather than HfNbTaTiZr and its thermal-expansion link remains weak, but A more fundamentally conflates dislocation-mediated plasticity with intrinsic elastic-modulus and thermal-expansion changes and offers little mechanistic discrimination.
